title: Scopebond rule pack (scopebond:pack/v1)
description: Closed schema: an unknown field or operator anywhere makes a pack invalid. A pack is signed data, never code: command grammars and MCP profiles that derive taxonomy actions, action_allowlist rules, and the vectors every engine runs. Cross-field rules a validator also enforces (validatePack): unique ids, no program read by two grammars, registered action types only, shell-only operators only in grammars and MCP-only ones only in profiles, patterns without nested repeats. Engine levels: requires and a rule's title, blockable, default_mode, safer_way and allow_patterns are level 2; a pack that uses one says requires.engine 2, and an action type it emits beyond the built-in registry is named in requires.action_types.

requires.description: Level 2: what an engine needs to read this pack. A pack that uses any level-2 field says engine 2 or more (validatePack checks it).

title.description: Level 2: the rule's name as a person reads it.

blockable.description: Level 2: the rule may block (it needs param_bounds).

default_mode.description: Level 2: what the rule does until a person or the workspace sets it (block only when blockable).

safer_way.description: Level 2: a plain hint for the coding agent, added to a denial's final instruction.

allow_patterns.description: Level 2: bounded ways an allowance under this rule may cover similar actions.
